name: hud_ui_text_input_shift_text_right
description: HudUiTextInput::ShiftTextRight shifts the current buffer contents right by count bytes from startPos when capacity allows, preserving the trailing NUL, and returns whether the shift was accepted.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiTextInput class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b4590 validates inline strlen via repne scasb, rejecting shifts when strlen(buffer) + count >= capacity, and copying bytes from the end while dst > startPos using buffer[dst] = buffer[dst - count].
Native smoke zhud_text_input_constructor_and_alloc_smoke exercises HudUiTextInput insertion and deletion paths that depend on ShiftTextRight preserving suffix bytes and the trailing NUL.
